author: Scout Springgate
title: 4-star 2027 WR spurns Iowa football for fellow Big Ten foe - NewsBreak
text:
By Scout Springgate ,
12 hours ago An Iowa Hawkeyes helmet lays on the field before a football game against the Indiana Hoosiers Sept. 27, 2025 at Kinnick Stadium in Iowa City, Iowa. By Julia Hansen/Iowa City Press-Citizen, Julia Hansen/Iowa City Press-Citizen / USA TODAY NETWORK via Imagn Images Despite a recent official visit to Iowa , 2027 four-star wide receiver Bennett Konkey announced his commitment to one of the Hawkeyes ' primary Big Ten rivals.
On Tuesday, Konkey revealed his decision to join the Illinois Fighting Illini .
After an official visit with the Fighting Illini this past weekend, the 6-foot-1, 185-pound speedster from Geneva, Illinois, picked the Illini over other Power Four offers from Iowa , Indiana, Northwestern, Wisconsin , Duke , Iowa State and Syracuse.
According to 247Sports , Konkey is the No. 238 player, the No. 35 wide receiver and the No. 12 prospect in Illinois in the 2027 class.
As a junior, Konkey had 41 receptions for 739 yards and nine touchdowns in nine games for Geneva High School.
While Iowa will need to look elsewhere on the recruiting front, the decision by Konkey should not be viewed as a major loss. The home-state Fighting Illini were viewed by many as the presumptive favorite for the speedy wide receiver.
